description: Lean X++ service DTOs for the existing screenshot tables. No new tables, EDTs, enums or columns are required. Technical portal metadata is stored in backend SQLite.
sqlite_only_metadata: resume filename and private blob reference
score justification and partly matched evidence
model deployment, prompt version and rubric version
notes: The only F&O operations are getOpenRequirements, submitApplication and saveCandidateEvaluation. Application history and ranking are read from SQLite.
Every business DataMember name is an existing screenshot field name. Company is company context; Success and Message are write acknowledgements, not table columns.
OpenDate and CloseDate are job eligibility dates and serialize as ISO YYYY-MM-DD text; they are not portal audit timestamps.
EvaluationCriteriaJson and RubricVersion are existing job business criteria and are read from UBJobRequirementTable. Per-run evaluation provenance remains in SQLite.
Company must equal the integration user current legal entity. getOpenRequirements is parameterless and reads that same legal entity.
The backend generates stable ApplicationId and EvaluationId before retryable writes; F&O must preserve those exact identifiers.

The portal sends the confirmed full name as CandidateName. FirstName and LastName remain optional input-only compatibility members for the previous client during an F&O-first rollout. LinkedInProfileUrl uses the actual UBCandidateTable field name.
MeetsMinimumCriteria and Success are JSON booleans, independent of table enum storage.
MatchedSkillsJson, MissingSkillsJson and EvidenceJson are JSON-array strings; they are not nested DTO arrays.
The full job description and resume comparison evidence must not be truncated by EDT lengths.
List attributes explicitly name both the accessor parameter and return type.
These files are pasteable source, not an importable or compiled model package. Build and verify against the actual field types in an F&O development environment.
